rawContent: @EPWVLaw @cspanwj Tea Party became the legit mainstay of the GOP party, after time.  But Occupy, the #FightFor15 Movement, #BlackLivesMatter, even Bernie Sanders mvmt  - none of the rising leftist groups have been allowed to exert any real power/control over D party.

I'll never understand how anyone can oppose #BlackLivesMatter's principles. 
They're arguing that unarmed black men shouldn't be killed by overly-sensitive police.  They're trying to save lives.

How can anyone disagree with this?
